description: See and commit every repository your agents touched, worktrees included, from a tab beside the thread. Each repository gets its own staged and unstaged lists, per-hunk staging, and a commit box where Claude can write the message in your repo's style. Compare any branch with main, then open a pull request on GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket. A file tree with git badges and a branch graph share the same tab and refresh from bb's file watcher. Needs git on the thread's machine; the commit-message button also needs an Anthropic API key, an ant login or the claude CLI.
